source-brainforge-ai-access-001.notes: Directly observable public evidence checked on 30 July 2026. The blog index is live and paginated. /llms.txt returns 200 with curated sections including agent-readable references. /robots.txt declares Content-Signal search=yes, ai-train=no, use=reference, disallows GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, CCBot, Bytespider, Applebot-Extended, Amazonbot and meta-externalagent, and leaves OAI-SearchBot, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, Googlebot and Bingbot allowed. Blog posts carry Article, BreadcrumbList, Person and WebPage structured data. Search Console figures are private and are NOT covered by this source.
